meaning: Minimum number of Characters taking part in the game for an Objective card to remain in its deck during setup.

officialSources.citation: printed page 10, Objective Setup and Character Draft, step 2
officialSources.text: Remove all cards with a Number of Characters symbol higher than the number of Characters taking part in the game.

officialSources.citation: Objectives Help Sheet pages 1–2; visible examples include 2+, 3+, 4+, and 5+ cards

comparison.result: S04 uses the same Number of Characters morphology; gray PROTOTYPE watermark overlap does not change the glyph identity.

manualReview.projectOwnerNote: apostrophe is obscured by awful kerning so it is easy to miss; the 10+ symbol seems to be a player symbol
manualReview.adjudication: Retain the apostrophe in Player10's; normalize the metadata glyph as [numberOfCharacters] using publisher terminology.
